EmailTemplate.subject: Is your AR process costing you customers?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, Your A/R process isn’t just about getting paid—it’s a big part of the customer experience.
If your invoice-to-cash workflow is slow, confusing, or disconnected, it could drive customers away, especially when it’s time to renew.
Here’s a stat: You’re 60–70% more likely to sell to an existing customer than a new one. That makes your A/R process a key lever for growth.
Our EVP, Ryan Frere, shares what leading teams are doing: 5 ways execs are rethinking A/R to fuel growth. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-b2b-companies-are-using-accounts-receivable-to-help-grow-their-business?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Want to chat about where your current process might be holding you back?
Best, Alex Godfrey
